tvc_director.name: tvc-director
tvc_director.purpose: Schedule 10 collaborative agents to deliver a product advertisement, gated by 6-axis configuration and explicit user confirmations.
tvc_director.style_inputs: Each agent may receive a tvc-style-* skill as additional creative grammar.

agents.name: TVC Agent Script
agents.description: Collect the user's selected short film duration (6 fixed options: 15s / 30s / 45s / 60s / 90s / 120s) and generate a narrative script (story arc, protagonist, conflict, scene outline, key beats) sized exactly to that duration.
do_not: Do not skip this step even if the user supplied a complete script in their raw request — the strong gate requires explicit user confirmation that the refined structure matches their intent.
Do not accept durations outside the 6 fixed options.
Do not generate scene durations whose sum differs from selected_duration.
Do not write shots, camera moves, or voiceover lines — those belong to shot-planning (Step 3) and voiceover (Step 5).

agents.name: TVC Agent Brief
agents.description: Extract a minimal viable brief and strategy-draft sentence from the user's raw request.
do_not: Do not propose product claims beyond what the user supplied.
Do not start creative strategy before the user confirms the brief.

agents.name: TVC Agent Strategy
agents.description: Author three differentiated creative routes and a 0-3 second hook design.
do_not: Do not begin scene planning until the user confirms a route.
Do not blend more than one route into a single output.

agents.name: TVC Agent Shot Planning
agents.description: Plan scene anchors, pacing tier, and shot handoffs with sound bridges.
do_not: Do not submit media tasks or include provider payloads.
Do not write shot-list prompts; that belongs to tvc-agent-video-prompt.

agents.name: TVC Agent Asset Storyboard
agents.description: Generate product, character, and scene assets, then compile the final storyboard.
do_not: Do not skip storyboard-final.png before any video generation.
Do not borrow references or Drafts from another shot.

agents.name: TVC Agent Voiceover
agents.description: Design a single primary VO list with timing and pacing controls.
do_not: Do not call edge-tts before the user confirms the VO text.
Do not narrate action; only add information not in the picture.

agents.name: TVC Agent Product Action
agents.description: Design product action force chains and casting/beauty direction.
do_not: Do not invent product features unsupported by the brief.
Do not propose casting that conflicts with the selected style.

agents.name: TVC Agent Food Flavor
agents.description: Visualize food flavor and mouthfeel through three-layer expression.
do_not: Do not run this agent for non-food products — orchestrator handles the skip via workflow.skip_when.
Do not mix taste words with abstract adjectives.

agents.name: TVC Agent Packshot
agents.description: Design Hero reveal, Packshot, and Endboard as the closing module.
do_not: Do not bake exact Logo or legal copy into video prompts.
Do not exceed 0.8-1.5s reveal plus 3.5-4.5s stable window.

agents.name: TVC Agent Video Prompt
agents.description: Author segment-by-segment self-contained video generation prompts.
do_not: Do not call agnes_video_generate directly; submit prompts only.
Do not invent duration, aspect ratio, resolution, or model names.
Do not reference earlier segments by name.

agents.name: TVC Agent QC
agents.description: Verify each upstream artifact against the brief and redlines before delivery.
do_not: Do not modify upstream artifacts.
Do not skip any QC dimension even if the time budget is tight.

styles.description: An advertising treatment built around belief-led narration, symbolic imagery, emotional escalation, and brand resolution.
An advertising treatment built around engineering form, material precision, functional demonstration, and controlled light.
An advertising treatment built around ingredient texture, process progression, steam and sound detail, and appetite-led reveal.
An advertising treatment built around selling-point hierarchy, use context, benefit reveal, and clean packshot logic.
An advertising treatment built around continuous spatial choreography, motivated transitions, and reveal timing.
An advertising treatment built around rhythmic camera accents, movement-to-cut coordination, and visual impact beats.

global_redlines: product_screen_share >= 70 percent across the full film
no consecutive 3 panels without product visibility
storyboard-final.png is a hard prerequisite for agnes_video_generate
no abstract banned words (cinematic / 电影感 / 高级感 / 氛围感) without translation to concrete camera/lighting parameters
product must drive the cause, not be a passive prop decorated with FX
